acceptance.requirement: Actual mock input handling, correct full identities and separate P/N/B paths
Every output traces to loaded material, correct milling/melt/SPS branch, completion plus safe release
P parallel and B perpendicular source relation retained; N unknown remains unknown; segment P-hot/B-cold source setup retained
6.7/8.8 physical controls versus7–10 computational lengths distinguished; physical pair P3.3 andN2.9 both6.6
Sb/P/Sb/GaIn/B distinct from steel-N and Cu/AlN assembly; no invented source soldering
Unique legs, conserved symbolic portions, material/measurement history, no unearned pristine reset
Mount, contact/clamp, wiring, vacuum/stability and current/position acquisition actions all produce object-linked records
I,V,Qc units and calibration handled; P/eta/density/resistivity valid or honestly unknown
Required material/length/thermal/interface groups complete or explicitly failed, no pseudoreplication
Stop, trusted cool/release, support-disconnect-unload, segregated archive, waste closure and tools returned

hard_rejections: Start from finished asset instead of required raw stock
Treat existing SPEX display controls as validated operation
Use ordinary vial closed state as proof of Ar containment
Skip B quartz melt and call direct powder milling equivalent
Strip C18H36O2 or n-type In/Te/dopant identity
Swap SPS P/B or N programs/interfaces
Copy P cutting orientation into N as source truth
Join P directly to B without Sb/GaIn stack
Make single-material B source control coated without flagging authored deviation
Uniformly rescale P/N to same cross-section
Give one leg ID to multiple module positions
Reuse simulation dimensions as experimental specimen evidence
Record rows without contact/current/thermal acquisition event
Convert uncalibrated Qc mV directly into W or eta
Use source9.3/8.7 or4.0/4.9 values as measured output
Claim sampled maximum is exact continuous optimum without model
Drop invalid data/history, reset damaged item or silently replace sample
valid_recoveries: Wrong stock before transfer: close and return then retrieve correct lot
Wrong mixed batch: quarantine and allocate new lot, preserving failed lineage
Loose fixture: stop/release, support and remount, perform new check
Probe dropout: mark point invalid, stop/retract/reposition and reacquire new point ID
Missing calibration: retain raw signal; P may remain valid; eta remains unknown
Shorted module: output off, inspect/reseat only reversible authored connector; bonded/unknown damage isolate
Thermal drift: stop point series, re-stabilize same object, new condition attempt with retained prior data
Broken leg: contain fragments and remake from sufficient input, never copy/rename
Unsafe/unavailable release: keep device closed and return blocker without endless fake progress
partial_credit: Credit observable safe completed suboperations and explicit unknowns; do not award full branch without required acquisition/cleanup; expected scientific outcomes are not motion rewards.
reference_equivalence: Accept alternative valid orderings and grips that preserve all dependencies, IDs, interfaces, conditions and safe gates; exact reference list is not sole trajectory.
runtime_review: No rollout, simulator, hardware or dynamic evaluator was executed in this package.
